Bombay High Court rules on helmet exemption for Sikhs

The Bombay High Court has clarified that the exemption for Sikhs from wearing helmets is not based on religion, but rather on the necessity of wearing a turban. The court dismissed a petition challenging this exemption, stating the reason behind it. This ruling addresses a long-standing practice and its legal justification.
